description: The Liberty II satellite has been taking over by Giger and his cybernetic assassins. Now it's up to Sentinel to assemble an elite team of Youngblood members to handle the situation. Riptide, Cougar, Photon, and Masada stand ready. But when Brahma refusing to answer the call to arms Sentinel must ask the one man he never wanted to see again for help. "Blackout." Story by Rob Liefeld. Art by Chap Yaep and Norm Rapmund.

Continued from Youngblood #6. Youngblood members Diehard, Combat, Vogue, and Dutch are on the trail of Giger's Cybernet organization and come face-to-face with some of the deadliest adversaries they've ever faced. Can they survive the onslaught of Maddock, Blackrock, Argus-2, Argus-14, and Warwolf. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Chap Yaep, Jon Sibal, and Marlo Alquiza. Plus pt.1 of "Melting Points." A back-up Tales of Team Youngblood story by Rob Liefeld, Robert Loren Fleming, Mark Pacella, Cedric Nocon, and Jon Sibal.

Continued from Spawn #23 and Youngblood #7. As the Boy of Stone, Badrock, was enjoying some R&R on the Ski slopes he was suddenly attacked by the damaged cyborg killing machine known as Overtkill. It's Badrock vs. Overtkill. And as if that wasn't enough, Sentinel and the rest of the team are shocked to find their former teammate Brahma has joined the ranks of the nefarious Four. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Chap Yaep, Danny Miki, and Marlo Alquiza, and Jonathan Sibal. 32 pages. Plus pt.2 of "Melting Points." A back-up Tales of Team Youngblood story by Rob Liefeld, Robert Loren Fleming, Mark Pacella, Cedric Nocon, and Jon Sibal. 32 pages. Includes a poster of Team Youngblood.

Team youngblood faces the Four. Brahma and Showdown, former youngblood members seem to had join the villainous side. 
But who is The Never Man ?
Sentinel and his Youngblood team faces a giant energy entity knows a The Never Man. Do you Brahma and Showdown, their former teammates are going to help them or fight them ?

Riptide is about to expose herself nude. 
Obviously, Graves disagree and the others team members have differents ways of thinking. 
And what about his future in the team if she'll do it ?

The new Men are Team youngblood's prisoners. In Andrews air force base, they try to explain how reign had kill a man and why they had fly from the authorities. 
In team Youngblood, the situation is difficult. Riptide is about to leave, fired by Graves after his nude photos publication and half the team is thinking that the New Men are good guys. 
In the same time, Pilot, Proctor, Khyber and the pregnant Dash find that Keever's aide, Higgins is part of the Brotherhood of Man. They succeed to free the New Men but, one more time, the Sentinel's team interpose. 
The battle between the two begins a second time. But Keever stops it after he discovers all the truth. Higgins has confess that the Brotherhood of Man had trick reign into murdering the man in the bar fight and had organised the team Younblood intervention. 
But Keever is took in hostage by another Brotherhood's mole but, after a xenophobiac speech, he burns alive without explication. 
The new Men's situation is clarrified. All seems calm when Dash is going into labor.

Keever tells Sentinel that he has been promoted to administrator and will be replaced as an active duty member of Youngblood by a Bloodpool cadet named Brett Butler. Sentinel is angered by all this, Graves suggests he takes a few days off which he does. During his time off he weighs the pros and cons of his new position but fails to reach a definitive conclusion about his future.

Extreme Sacrifice part 7 of 8. Polybagged with card. Rob Liefeld story. Robert Napton script. John Stinsman & John Fang pencils. Jaime Mendoza inks.

Note cover was misprinted as 7 of 8

Extreme Sacrifice Part 6 (of 8)

Graves has gathered every members of Youngblood, Brigade and Newmen he has been able to find as to prepare them for the big battle. Shaft enters the room where everybody is and finds his father, Colonel Bravo, that he hasn't seen in a long time. That's at this moment that Knight Sabre tells shaft that he and his father are part of the Order of the Knights, a group of super-powered heroes that appears when the danger is universal.

The meeting is of short minutes as Crypt enters the place, throwing a Warwolf in bad-shape through the window. Link is the first to ripost but his attack is stopped by a newcomer : Newborn, son of Reign and Dash. He seems prepared for this fight since his recent birth as he takes the gem of Reign and sends a blast to Cyrpt. But Crypt is better than that and eliminate him in a blink of an eye.

After that, it's a general battle as everybody attack Crypt. Sentinel II receives the hammer stolen from Supreme and seems K.O. The devilish warrior destroys hero after hero and when he is about to finish Dash the surprise arrives. Sentinel II is back and tries to kill Crypt thanks to his fusion reaction. Exit creates a huge portal to send the shrapnels elsewhere as to save his friends but the explosion is too strong.

The dust falls and all that Graves and Kombat can see is the whole teams lying on the floor, and Crypt escaping..

.. that's at this very moment that Prophet and Kirby make their entering..

Keever and Shaft reassemble the Youngblood team in order to rescue the millionaire business man Robert Thomas from a group of terrorists. But it turns out that it was all an elaborate setup to discredit Youngblood and frame Dutch for the murder of an innocent man.

Youngblood and the authorities try to track down Dutch who is on the run after being accused of murder. While on the run Dutch meets a woman named Marla Thomas who may have some evidence that will help prove his innocence. Meanwhile Diehard and the remaining members of Youngblood investigate an Katellan vessel that has suddenly appeared near the moon.

As the elite team of Youngblood members, Sentinel, Riptide, Cougar, Photon, Masada, and Dutch storm the Liberty II satellite, Brahma is approached by his old enemy Showdown and offered a place within the ranks of the evil Four. Plus, The ultra powerful psychokinetic Psi-Fire has escaped and is out for payback. Story by Rob Liefeld. Art by Chap Yaep and Norm Rapmund.

Keever informs Shaft that the government is shutting Bloodpool after a brief argument Shaft leaves as Keever is called away to sub level four. Keever arrives and is shocked to see a much older looking Badrock, who explains that he is from the future and has gone back in time to help Youngblood stop the Katellans from taking over the universe.

Maximage teleports into Keever's office warning him that the world is in danger if Celestine retrieves the Elemental Fire. Maximage teleports the Team Youngblood members to the Orbital Angel Station so they can help Youngblood.

Meanwhile, Angela and Glory are engaged in a battle with Celestine's troops. They agree they need to cut off Celestine's power source, the Elemental Fire.

On the Orbital Angel Station, Team Youngblood arrives to help Youngblood. Maximage discovers the Elemental Fire is being piped into the station from Heaven. She severs the link and all of the Angel servants turn into mortals.

Upon returning to Earth Youngblood is ordered to leave the angels alone and let the others handle the situation. Maximage heads over to investigate but suddenly falls to the Earth as her powers fail.
Youngblood and the Shadowhawk Robot do battle on the Brooklyn Bridge until the Newmen show up and stop the fight.

This is it the final show down between Team Youngblood and Giger's cyborg killing machines. With the world watching Sentinel and Dutch go head-to-head with the deadly cyborg Giger. If they fail the planet Earth is doomed. Guest-starring Battlestone of Brigade. Spawn, Prophet, and Savage Dragon cameos. Story by Rob Liefeld. Art by Chap Yaep and Norm Rapmund.

As Sentinel addresses the media in the aftermath of Team Youngblood's victory aboard the Liberty II, the rest of the team enjoys some much needed R&R. This issue explores the characters and gives some more insight into who they are. Sentinel also learns of Psi-Fire's escape. Story by Rob Liefeld. Art by Chap Yaep and Norm Rapmund. Plus pt.1 of "The Coming of Cougar!" A back-up Tales of Team Youngblood story by Rob Liefeld, Eric Stephenson, Mark Pacella, and Marlo Alquiza.

Cougar returns to the place of his birth, the secret home of the cat-people, in search of his missing mother. He then finds himself in a fight to the death for honor and the life of his mother. Meanwhile, back at HQ, Psi-Fire makes his move, and Photon and Dutch are the only ones present to try and stop him. "Cat People!" Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Cedric Nocon and Norm Rapmund. Plus pt.2 of "The Coming of Cougar!" A back-up Tales of Team Youngblood story by Rob Liefeld, Eric Stephenson, Mark Pacella, and Marlo Alquiza.

Psi-fire is back with a vengeance! Can even the elite Youngblood team of Sentinel, Riptide, Cougar, Photon, Masada, and Dutch possibly hope to defeat this psychokinetic juggernaut. Plus, an interlude that sets the stage for the Extreme Prejudice crossover event. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Cedric Nocon and Norm Rapmund. Includes a 2 page back-up story of Black and White.

Extreme Prejudice crossover pt.1. The immensely powerful mutant Quantum has escaped his imprisonment and plans to make everyone suffer. As Team Youngblood falls one-by-one what hope is there for mankind? Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Chap Yaep, Dan Panosian, and Norm Rapmund. Includes a 2 page back-up story of Black and White. 32 pages. Includes coupon #1 of 7 for Extreme Prejudice #0.

issue_title: Extreme Prejudice, Part 5: Everything to Lose
description: Extreme Prejudice crossover pt. 5. Team Youngblood, Brigade, Bloodstrike, even the powerful Supreme have all had a crack at Quantum, and they have all failed. Now, it's time to set aside old differences and throw everything they have at this nigh unstoppable menace. It's everyone vs. Quantum. Story continues in Brigade #9 and Bloodstrike #10. Guest-starring Brigade, Bloodstrike, and the New Men. Story by Rob Liefeld and Eric Stephenson. Art by Chap Yaep, Jon Sibal, and Marlo Alquiza. 32 pages. Includes coupon #5 of 7 for Extreme Prejudice #0.

It's the return of the home team. This is a great jumping on point for new readers as Team Youngblood welcomes back original members Diehard, Vogue, Combat, and Badrock. Story by Rob Liefeld. Art by Danny Miki and Kiko Taganashi.                                                                               

Shaft and Badrock are fighting each other in the training room. After some time spending to receive arrows and jokes from Shaft, Badrock wins the fight.

During this time, a new member arrives from Australia, Knight Sabre. He thinks about the future popularity he'll enjoy after being introduced to the Youngblood program.

Troll finds Graves in his office and has a conversation about his presence in the team, Graves answers that it's not about unpopularity but controversy. Troll seems intrigued but has to stay in the program as Graves informs him that these are bad days for Youngblood.

While Shaft is searching for Die Hard, we find Vogue and Die Hard having some close hugs, which surprises Shaft as he discovers them. Vogue explains to him that Die Hard ain't a robot but a cyborg which is very different for her. There is something human inside of him, more than what Shaft thinks.

After this short encounter, Sentinel shows his private side. His relationship has gone bad and he needs to speak with Keever about that.

Riptide and Masada have a training session too and Cougar and Photon would like to go to a party and save a bank from robbery instead of training. Everybody is speaking about the program in a different way, but what Graves told Troll earlier seems to make sense now more than ever: Youngblood is in bad shape.
